Title: Generally Available: Node auto-provisioning support in Sovereign Cloud

Body.Content:
Node auto‑provisioning removes the need for teams to manually size and manage compute resources for Kubernetes workloads. Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) now provides general availability support for node auto‑provisioning in Sovereign Cloud. This capability automatically provisions, manages, and scales compute nodes based on workload requirements. It helps technical practitioners reduce operational overhead, improve resource utilization, and maintain consistent performance without manual intervention.  

Learn more.
